glosses: spectacular (amazing or worthy of special attention)

examples.en: This is going to be spectacular.

examples.text: Quero lhe mostrar uma vista espetacular.
examples.en: I want to show you a spectacular view.

examples.text: Há algumas coisas espetaculares naquele sítio.
examples.en: There are some spectacular things on that site.

examples.text: A vista do topo da montanha era espetacular.
examples.en: The view from the mountain top was spectacular.
